[Verse 1]
[F#]The fossils of my footsteps will
[C#]be unearthed At a far off date unknown
[F#]Impressed in [F#sus2]concrete from
[C#]walking home alone [C#/D#]After walking you
[F#sus2]home
[F#]And the mops of greasy hair
[C#]Will romanticize my des-
[F#]pair But [F#sus2]they won't know
[C#][C#/D#]That I didn't care

[Chorus]
[A#m]I [G#sus4]like the [C#]silence [C#5]
[F#sus2]I like the empty streets
[A#m]Crawl [G#sus4]down [C#]'em on [C#5]hands
[F#sus2]and knees in a heart-
[A#m]beat [G#sus4][C#]If [C#5]I had
[F#sus2]to
[A#m]I owe 'em that [G#]at the very least
[F#]

[Verse 2]
[F#]The map had faded out, but I
[C#]could have sworn I noted every stride
[F#]I guess the [F#sus2]rain hit Be-
[C#]fore the ink could dry [C#/D#]
[F#]And where I thought I'd be
[C#]Was not what I perceived
[F#]Assessing the [F#sus2]progress From be-
[C#]neath your sheets [C#/D#]That's why

[Chorus]
[A#m]I [G#sus4]need the [C#]silence [C#5]
[F#sus2]I need the empty streets
[A#m]Just [G#sus4]as bad [C#]as they [C#5]don't
[F#sus2]need me It's a sick,
[A#m]sad [G#sus4]sham [C#]of [C#5]a ma-
[F#sus2]rriage But it's all there is
[A#m]It's [G#]all I need
[F#]
[F#m]

[Bridge]
[F#sus2]I can be
[G#sus4][A#m]everything you need
[F#sus2]If you make
[C#5]me [C#sus2]
[F#sus2]I can be
[A#m]every [G#sus4]crack in your con-
[F#sus2]crete If you
[C#5]let me off [C#sus2]easy
[F#sus2]I can be
[G#sus4][A#m]easily deceived
[F#sus2]If you want
[C#5]that [C#sus2]
[F#sus2]But you are the
[A#m]ember [G#sus4]of my heart
[F#sus2]Whether you like
[C#5]that [C#sus2]or not
[F#]
